label: Judgement heuristics and biases
text: MS.O.A1.5.2 Judgement heuristics (availability, representativeness, anchoring; Tversky and Kahneman 1974). They are biases relative to a stated normative model. The rule of thumb used by an analyst is a different sentence, in the register.

warrant.standard: Effect replicates across paradigms with stated range
